name: weather-scalar-augmented
description: Weather real task, scalar vs augmented. One real task (de-identified weather station CSV: 21 channels, 10-minute sampling), two arms, three seeds, 25 candidates per cell. The config is the main-v3 config (inputLength 96, horizon 24); the incumbent is m0-patchtst. The endpoint is the relative MSE ratio MSE(final)/MSE(m0) after the uniform m0+g postprocessing (no oracle). Independent of main-v3.json, which stays frozen.

tasks.name: real-weather
